{
  "constraints": [
    "Scope is coding agents only. Do not introduce game, NPC, OntOS, or general-purpose product surfaces in this program.",
    "Use TraceDecay V2 PR #707 head 08fbe33a7c7f403191fd5d6e356c7b6681b96403 as the initial upstream floor.",
    "Preserve TraceDecay as authority for current code, repository/worktree identity, sessions, tools, approvals, and host integration.",
    "Memory-provider output is advisory context. It cannot silently mutate canonical code truth or TraceDecay Native facts.",
    "Keep all work in this monorepo, but isolate product-owned code in dedicated crates and narrow composition-root mounts.",
    "TraceDecay Native, NCM, and future OCEAN must sit behind one capability-based provider boundary; never branch on provider names outside registry/adapters.",
    "No silent fallback, fake readiness, placeholder success, swallowed error, unbounded queue, or undocumented authority.",
    "Every production path must propagate deadlines and cancellation, return typed terminal outcomes, preserve provenance, and enforce exact project/worktree scope.",
    "All writes must be idempotent and crash-recoverable. Observer providers must never affect prompts, canonical facts, or externally visible actions.",
    "Do not close a bead without its acceptance checklist, focused tests, and at least one real product journey where applicable.",
    "Track every intentional edit to Zack-owned files in the upstream convergence map with rationale and semantic invariants.",
    "Use Beads Rust JSONL as the versioned planning authority; keep the SQLite database local and rebuildable."
  ],
  "deliverables": [
    "Provider API and capability registry",
    "TraceDecay Native adapter with parity",
    "NCM adapter and guarded observer/active modes",
    "Observation dispatch, recall integration, feedback, maintenance, inspection, and conformance",
    "Coding-agent journeys for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, multi-worktree, restart, stale correction, and provider failure",
    "Repeatable upstream convergence workflow for Zack and structured lesson intake from Jeffrey"
  ],
  "objective": "Deliver a pluggable cognitive-memory layer inside the TraceDecay V2 monorepo for coding agents.",
  "references": [
    "https://github.com/ScriptedAlchemy/tracedecay/pull/707",
    "https://github.com/BleedingDev/tracedecay/tree/feat/pluggable-memory-providers-v2",
    "https://github.com/bleedingDev/biomem",
    "https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_rust"
  ]
}
